rows.grounds: compound brāhmaṇya+cihnam; nominative singular neuter predicate
compound sūtra+dhāraṇam; nominative singular neuter subject

items.question: What constitutes the sole remaining mark of brahminhood for such degraded individuals?
premises: The described individuals lack faith and devotion.
Their conduct is characterized as degraded and impure.
No substantive brahminical qualities remain attributed to them.
items.inference: Therefore, wearing the sacred thread alone is identified as their only mark of brahminhood.
uncertainties: Whether sūtradhāraṇam is intended as a purely external ritual marker or also implies a hollow claim to status is not explicit.
items.plain_english: For them, the only mark of being a brahmin is the wearing of the sacred thread.
